rationale: With only 8 minutes remaining until the market close, the expected breakout above $12.00 has stalled, with the last five 1-minute candles printing lower highs from $12.09 down to $12.02. Given the lack of upward momentum and the tight remaining daily loss budget ($257.10), closing at a near-scratch (-$3.88) avoids unnecessary market-on-close liquidation risk. Flipping to short is unwarranted as the price remains above both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($11.94) and session VWAP ($11.87).
